title: Investigating CTGAN Usage in CTR Prediction Tasks
summary: A study on Huawei's ad click-through-rate dataset that trains CTGAN to generate synthetic minority-class samples under feature selection, down-sampling, and permutation variants, then evaluates downstream CatBoost classification utility. It runs both the standalone ctgan package and SDV's sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to produce and reload the synthetic data.
